title: VisIT-Bench: A Benchmark for Vision-Language Instruction Following Inspired by Real-World Use

bias_targets.methodology: Running two queries covering both possible orderings of candidate responses ('A' and 'B') during automatic evaluation to mitigate the LLM judge's preference for a specific position.
Incorporating the NLVR2 dataset to evaluate visual reasoning skills and test whether models rely on textual/linguistic priors rather than actual image grounding.
